en.headline: Immigration Department repatriates 21 Vietnamese nationals including failed claimants
en.dek: Twenty illegal immigrants and one overstayer were removed to Vietnam on Thursday, all unsubstantiated non-refoulement claimants, some of whom had served prison sentences.
body: The Immigration Department carried out a repatriation operation on Thursday, removing 20 Vietnamese illegal immigrants and one overstayer to Vietnam.

The 21 persons, comprising 14 men and seven women, were all unsubstantiated non-refoulement claimants. Among them were discharged prisoners who had committed criminal offences and completed their sentences.

The department said it remains committed to promptly removing unsubstantiated claimants to maintain effective immigration control. Under the updated policy effective since December 2022, removals can generally proceed after a claimant’s judicial review is dismissed by the Court of First Instance.
Officials said they will continue to explore ways to speed up repatriations and coordinate with relevant parties to optimise removal routes and procedures.

zh.headline: 入境處強制遣返21名越南籍免遣返聲請不獲確立人士
zh.dek: 周四遣返20名非法入境者及一名逾期逗留人士至越南，全部為聲請不獲確立者，部分曾服刑。
body: 入境事務處周四執行遣送行動，將20名越南籍非法入境者及一名逾期逗留人士遣返越南。
該批人士包括14男7女，全部為免遣返聲請不獲確立者，當中包括曾因刑事罪行被判監並已刑滿出獄的人士。
入境處表示一直致力盡快遣送聲請不獲確立者，以維持有效出入境管制。根據2022年12月起生效的更新政策，一般可在司法覆核被高等法院原訟法庭拒絕後執行遣送。
署方稱會繼續研究加快遣返的方案，並與相關單位協調優化路線及流程。
